subject: model
value: One row is one PDF file at one path in the J.G. Savard site-capture corpus, recording that file's filesystem facts, pdfinfo metadata, text-extraction outcome, and proposed rename/title inference.
justification: DDL declares id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid alias) and path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE - the only UNIQUE, and sqlite_master holds only sqlite_autoindex_documents_1. builder_path is null, so the sibling .local/references/research-pdfs/catalog.sqlite (byte-identical DDL; manifest.json says JGSavard was "split out from research-pdfs") is authority on the 10 uniqueness subjects. There sha256 1a1c2123... occurs on two distinct paths (...arXiv.pdf, ...arXiv v2.pdf), title repeats (including ''), and creation_date is NULL in 8 rows: sha256, title, creation_date are not keys. title and text_path are nullable in DDL (text_ok/text_error exist precisely for failed extraction). size_bytes, text_chars and inferred_title (a truncated first-page snippet) are coincidental at n=81. filename and suggested_name are basenames: this corpus spans two directories (root and SlideRule/) yet suggested_folder is 'JGSavard' for all 81 rows, so the rename flattens the subdirectory and same-named files collide while path stays unique - exactly why UNIQUE sits on path. Scope is current-state: path->sha256/size_bytes/text_chars describe the file as scanned, and the ALTER-appended review columns (original_title...inference_notes) show in-place enrichment, not per-build regeneration; path UNIQUE excludes historical.
